resources.string: Android updates are checked on startup or return to the foreground, at most once every 24 hours after a successful check; failed automatic checks retry after an hour. You can also check manually. The latest desktop release is queried separately when About opens. Choose to download in your browser and install with Android.
The Android client is up to date.
Cannot access the Android release API. Open Android releases in your browser; no GitHub token is required in this app.
GitHub has limited update checks. Try again later or open Android releases.
Could not verify an official Android release and its APK. Open Android releases to review available downloads.
Android update check failed. Check your network and try again, or open Android releases. Hub data is unchanged.
Unable to open the browser. Enable a browser to view Android releases and download the APK.
